text:
I thought I'd do a little comparison before we move into 2016

my first year of taking art somewhat seriously (as in, trying to improve at it)

I do think I improved quite a bit, mainly in terms of consistency

and, one thing I sadly cannot show or catalogue the way I do with visual improvement, time

time spent on a piece is probably the biggest improvement I've seen

the more I draw, the faster I can put an idea out there

speed ≠ quality, of course, but personally it helps against frustration to be able to tell when a sketch isn't gonna work out after 10min instead of needing an hour to be able to judge that 

of course, even 12 years later I am still learning and improving so take anything I say with a grain of salt and do your own research ;>
